news.headline: Lilly Left Nektar Drug 'Damaged Goods,' Jury Told At Trial End
news.summary: Closing arguments concluded in Nektar's roughly $1 billion breach-of-contract jury trial against Eli Lilly over rezpegaldesleukin, with Nektar's counsel arguing Lilly turned the drug into 'damaged goods' by breaching the 2017 co-development deal and favoring a competing drug it later acquired. The case is now with the jury; no verdict had been announced as of September 20, 2026.

news.headline: BTIG Reiterates Buy Rating on Nektar Therapeutics, Price Target $178
news.summary: BTIG Research reiterated a Buy rating on NKTR with a $178 price target, implying substantial upside from current levels as investors position ahead of the Q4 2026 REZOLVE-AA durability data readout.

news.headline: Nektar Enters Quiet Period Ahead of REZOLVE-AA 24-Week Off-Treatment Data as Eli Lilly Trial Opens
news.summary: Nektar announced a quiet period beginning September 8, 2026 through the public disclosure of topline data from the 24-week off-treatment follow-up period of the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA alopecia areata study (expected Q4 2026). The same day, opening statements began in Nektar's jury trial against Eli Lilly, with Nektar alleging Lilly 'sabotaged' rezpeg's development and could owe close to $1 billion in damages.

news.headline: Nektar Announces Publication in The Lancet of Positive Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD 16-Week Induction Results
news.summary: Peer-reviewed 16-week induction results from the 393-patient Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD study were published in The Lancet, confirming rezpegaldesleukin met all primary and key secondary endpoints in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, lending independent validation ahead of the Phase 3 ZENITH AD program.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Nektar reported a narrower-than-expected Q2 2026 loss and ended the quarter with roughly $1.02 billion in cash and investments (versus $245.8 million at year-end 2025), providing a runway into Q3 2028 that covers the Phase 3 ZENITH AD atopic dermatitis data expected mid-2028.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program Evaluating Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: Nektar dosed the first patients in ZENITH AD-1 and ZENITH AD-2, the first two of three global registrational Phase 3 trials of rezpegaldesleukin in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis (~1,530 patients total across the program), with initial data expected mid-2028.

catalysts.label: EADV 2026 Congress oral presentations (Vienna)
catalysts.detail: Full data presentations on REZOLVE-AD maintenance/durability results (monthly vs. quarterly dosing) and REZOLVE-AA 52-week topline data, presented by Dr. Thomas Bieber and Dr. David Rosmarin respectively.

catalysts.label: REZOLVE-AA 24-week off-treatment (durability) data readout
catalysts.detail: Topline data from the 24-week off-treatment follow-up period of the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA alopecia areata study — tests whether hair regrowth persists after dosing stops, the key durability question versus JAK inhibitor competitors. Company is in a quiet period until this is disclosed.

catalysts.label: Nektar v. Eli Lilly jury verdict
catalysts.detail: Verdict expected in the ~$1 billion breach-of-contract trial over rezpegaldesleukin's prior co-development deal; closing arguments concluded September 18, 2026 and the case is now with a California federal jury.

catalysts.label: Planned start of registrational Phase 3 alopecia areata trial
catalysts.detail: Nektar plans to initiate a single registrational Phase 3 study of rezpegaldesleukin in alopecia areata, contingent on the REZOLVE-AA durability data.

catalysts.label: Initial Phase 3 ZENITH AD data (atopic dermatitis)
catalysts.detail: First readout from the ZENITH AD registrational program (ZENITH AD-1/AD-2/AD-3, ~1,530 patients total), the pivotal data package intended to support a future BLA in atopic dermatitis.

pulse: Nektar is at a legal and clinical inflection point simultaneously: its ~$1 billion breach-of-contract jury trial against Eli Lilly over rezpegaldesleukin wrapped closing arguments on September 18, 2026 and is awaiting a verdict, while the company remains in a self-imposed quiet period ahead of the pivotal REZOLVE-AA 24-week off-treatment durability data due in Q4 2026. Fundamentals are solid — ~$1.02 billion in cash as of Q2 2026 funds operations into Q3 2028, Phase 3 ZENITH AD trials in atopic dermatitis are enrolling, and peer-reviewed Lancet publication of positive REZOLVE-AD data has reinforced sell-side bullishness (BTIG $178 PT, Piper Sandler $192 PT). The stock has been volatile but up sharply year-to-date, with the market pricing in optionality from both the litigation outcome and the upcoming alopecia durability readout as the next major share-price catalysts.
